mechanic: Mancala board with stone dots and two stores. Correct question unlocks a turn; wrong gives the bot a turn. Sowing into the home store grants an extra turn WITHOUT a question. Standard opposite capture and final stone sweep decide the winner.
questionCountNote: 50 unique questions per level. A round only ever moves forward through them: losing, answering wrong, or pressing Play again continues at the next unseen question, so the pool must outlast many rounds.
distractorRules: Wrong options must be the same kind of thing as the right one — same units, same part of speech, same level of detail, similar length. For number work the distractors must be plausible miscalculations at this level, never oddballs identifiable at a glance.
